artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic boundary checks, real-normal sharp-witness checks, random tests of the two-point lower certificate, numerical minimization, and the common-step benchmark.
Verified output with software versions, deterministic seed, representative parameter values, error levels, and PASS status.

limitations: Affine real normal operators, Euclidean norm, exact arithmetic, known positive parameters, and one stationary degree-two cycle only. Nonnormal transient growth, projections, nonlinear operators, adaptive or nonstationary methods, momentum, higher-degree methods, and long-horizon complexity are outside the claim.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, and the dated independent assessment are documented in the record files.
record_title: Exact degree-two minimax and asymmetric extragradient on normal strongly monotone systems
scientific_context: For real normal affine operators with symmetric part at least a positive lower bound and spectral norm at most a positive upper bound, a degree-two minimax polynomial gives exact one-cycle contraction and is realized by unequal-step extragradient.
